text:
Source-assisted reading of Stams Frg. 33, piece 33-1 (F-dxj5). It was made after the image-only first reading and with the Sarum Breviary (ed. Procter-Wordsworth, cols. mxlviii-mxlix) in view. Reread on the image: face A, lines 1-7 (lesson 1), the R1 lines, lesson 2, the R2/verse lines, and the last line; face B, two lines. Conventions: ( ) expansion, [ ] lost or supplied, (?) uncertain. Boxes are native pixels.

Canvas 0 (Stams_STA_Frg_033_01r05r), face A, box 5650,1360,6600,1960 (lesson 1; right edge cut, line above l.1 lost):

2  tentem. uni(us) sub(stanti)e. uni(us) potestatis. crea[to-]
3  [rem] omnium creaturarum. Credimus patrem [a se ip-]
4  [so] n(on) ab alio. filium a patre genitum. d(eu)m ue[rum]
5  de deo u(er)o. lumen u(er)um de lumine u(ero). sp[m]
6  [s(an)c(tu)m] a patre et filio equaliter procedentem. [consub-]
7  [stantia]lem(?) coeternum patri et filio. [red R]
